visual_review.assessment: Six complete golden treasure-goblin poses preserve goggles, one screen-left dagger, strapped loaded sack and bare clawed feet. Leg/knee changes are genuine, but the same near leg stays ahead through too much of the cycle. One bounded correction did not establish an unambiguous opposite-leg stride; original kept.
